title: Admission Process, CAP Rounds and Seat Allotment
content: Admissions to B.Tech programs are conducted through the Centralized Admission Process (CAP) based on MHT-CET and JEE Main score percentiles. Candidates must register on the state CET portal, submit documents for verification, fill option forms for college and branch preferences, and accept seat allotments across CAP Round 1, Round 2, and Round 3.
